marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southwest 15 knots this evening then
veering to west 20 near midnight. Wind west 20 Wednesday. Snow changing to scattered flurries near noon Wednesday.
Risk of freezing drizzle Wednesday. Fog patches dissipating late this
evening. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
